5.1 In the event that the Receiving Party is commanded, summoned or legally compelled by a binding decree, writ, injunction or formal order issued by a court of competent jurisdiction, or by a lawful demand of an administrative or governmental supervisory authority possessing regulatory jurisdiction, to disclose any portion of the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information, the Receiving Party shall:
5.1.1 advise the Disclosing Party in writing as promptly as possible, and in any case prior to making such disclosure, provided that such advance notification is not expressly prohibited by mandatory provisions of public order or criminal procedure;
5.1.2 consult in good faith with the Disclosing Party regarding the appropriate avenues to oppose, limit, challenge or restrict the scope of the demanded disclosure; and
5.1.3 in the event that disclosure cannot be avoided, disclose exclusively that portion of the Confidential Information which is strictly demanded by the judicial or administrative order, and use all reasonable commercial efforts to demand confidential and protected treatment for any data so released.
